description: This app's OWN webviews talk to their own backend: invoke the app's commands, listen to its lane events, drive their own chrome. Nothing wider. The board pop-out is named too — it runs the same document and reads the same commands, so a capability that skipped it would be a window with no events. Named as webviews rather than windows on purpose: a windows grant covers every webview OF the window, and the main window now hosts browser panes showing other people's pages — the one audience this capability must never reach.
